name: rlm
description: Recursive, evidence-backed analysis for repositories and large document sets with safe capability fallbacks

interface.shortDescription: Analyze repositories with recursive, bounded exploration.
interface.longDescription: RLM maps large repositories and document sets, uses budgeted recursion only when direct evidence is insufficient, validates uncertain claims independently, and synthesizes concise findings with coverage limits.
defaultPrompt: Review this repository with RLM and prioritize confirmed findings.
Trace this change across callers, tests, and configuration.
Audit this project for security, reliability, and missing tests.
